author: Athul Prem
scope: The 24-sided chord polygon retains 48 finite-element edges per rim and the original element connectivity. Moving alternating rim vertices changes the wall shape, solid volume and geometry of wall-adjacent tetrahedra. The comparison measures their finite combined effect at 1 GHz. Phases use the original physical end planes. Power changes are candidate minus reference. The equal-incoherent mean uses equal incident power in the five native propagating inputs. Continuum error and spatial or frequency convergence remain unresolved.
